title: Isolate release lint configuration
summary: Prevent the standalone release from inheriting duplicate Next.js ESLint plugins from the surrounding workspace.

changes.detail: Mark the release ESLint configuration as root after independent dependency installs exposed conflicting parent plugins.

validation.name: Focused release lint
validation.detail: Six changed storefront and lesson files checked; zero errors and two existing no-img-element warnings on the homepage.

validation.name: Production build
validation.detail: Build completed with 223 pages using non-secret service placeholders. Its lint phase identified the configuration conflict, subsequently fixed and verified by focused lint.
